senses.gloss:
(औइर्) औ विचिर् r. 7th cl. (विनक्ति विंक्ते)
1 To differ, to be separate or distinct. To divide, to separate, especially in judgment, to discriminate, to judge.

m. (-लः)
1 A kind of jasmine.
2 A flower, commonly Dona, (Artemisia.)
3 A shrub, (Vangueria spinosa)
E.
वि before चक to be satisfied, इलच् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Clever, able, wise, sensible.
2 Proficient, skilful.
m. (-णः)
A learned Brahman or Paṇḍita, a holy teacher.
E.
वि before चक्ष to speak, (sensibly,) and युच् aff.

mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु)
1 Blind.
2 Sad, perplexed.
E.
वि privative, चक्षुस् the eye.

m. (-यः)
Search, research.
E.
वि before चि to collect, aff. अच्.

n. (-नं)
Search, research, seeking.
E.
वि before चि to collect, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-नं)
Research, enquiry.
E.
वि before चि to collect, ल्युट् aff., and the vowel of the prefix made long.

mfn. (-रत्-रन्ती-रत्)
Wandering, roaming, going about.
E.
वि variously, चर to go, शतृ aff.

f. (-का)
Herpes, scab.
E.
वि before चर्च्च to speak or tell, aff. ण्वुल्.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Unsteady, unfixed, moving, going.
2 Conceited.
E.
वि before चल the same.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Intervening, intermediate.
E.
वि disjunctive prefix, चल to go, aff. अण्.

mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्)
Moving, going, shaking, waving.
E.
वि before चल to go, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Fickleness, unsteadiness.
2 Self-praise, conceit.
3 Deviating from.
E.
वि before चल to go, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Gone, departed.
2 Deviated from.
E.
वि before चल to go, क्त aff.

m. (-रः)
1 The exercise of judgment or reason on a present object, investigation, consideration, deliberation.
2 Dispute, discussion.
E.
वि before चर to go, aff. घञ्.

m. (-कः)
An investigator, a judge.
E.
वि before चर to go, causal v., ण्वुल् aff.

f. (-ता)
Investigation, discussion.
E.
तल् added to the last; also त्व, विचारकत्व.

m. (-र्त्ता)
A judge, an investigator.
E.
विचार, and कर्त्तृ who makes.

nf. (-णं-णा)
Deliberation, investigation, the exercise of judgment, or decision after due examination or discussion.
f. (-णा)
The Mīmāṃsā system of philosophy.
E.
वि before चर to go, causal form, aff. युच्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be discussed or investigated.
E.
वि before चर to go, causal v., अनीयर् aff.

f. (-भूः)
1 The judgment seat of YAMA, the judge of the dead.
2 Any meeting for literary or judicial investigation.
E.
विचार discussion or judgment, and भू place.

n. (-लं)
A logical disputation.
E.
विचार, and स्थल place.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Judged, discussed, determined, decided.
E.
विचार discussion, aff. इतच्.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Judging, discussing.
E.
वि before चर to go, णिनि aff.

mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
To be discussed, weighed, deliberated. &c.
ind.
Having deliberated.
E.
वि before चर to go, causal v., ण्यत् or ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Being investigated or discussed.
E.
वि before चर to go, passive v., शानच् aff.

f. (-चिः-ची)
A wave.
E.
वि before चि to collect, क्विप् aff., also वीची.

mf. (-चिः-चिः or -ची)
1 A wave.
2 A small or rippling wave.
3 Pleasure, delight, happiness.
4 Leisure, interval, rest.
5 A ray of light.
6 Small, little.
E.
वेञ् to weave, Uṇādi aff. ईचि, and the radical vowel rejected.

f. (-सा)
1 Doubt, uncertainty.
2 Error, mistake.
E.
वि before कित to doubt, in the reduplicate form, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं)
1 Variegated, spotted.
2 Painted, coloured.
3 Handsome, beautiful.
4 Wonderful, surprising.
n. (-त्रं)
1 Variegated, (the colour.)
2 Surprise.
3 Speech implying apparently the reverse of the object intended.
E.
वि before चित्र variegated, &c.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Wonderful, surprising.
n. (-कं)
Astonishment, wonder.
E.
कन् added to the last.

n. (-कं)
Shot or watered China silk.
E.
विचित्र, and चीनांशुक China cloth.

f. (-ता)
1 Wonder, wonderfulness.
2 Being variegated, variety of colour or tint, &c.
E.
विचित्र, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, विचित्रत्वं.

mfn. (-हः-ही-हं)
1 Having the body painted, &c.
2 Elegant.
m. (-हः)
A cloud.
E.
विचित्र spotted, variegated, (with different tints,) and देह the body.

m. (-र्य्यः)
A sovereign, the 22nd monarch of the lunar dynasty in the third age, the son of ŚĀNTANU and husband of PĀṆḌU'S mother.
E.
विचित्र wonderful, वीर्य्य power.

f. (-सूः)
The mother of VICITRAVĪRYA by ŚĀNTANU; also of VYĀSA by PARĀŚARA.
E.
विचित्रवीर्य्य as above, and सू the mother.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
1 Elegant, well-formed, handsome.
2 Having the body of various colours.
m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A peacock.
2 A tiger.
E.
विचित्र variegated or beautiful, and अङ्ग the body.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Wonderful.
2 Painted, variegated.
E.
विचित्र, and इतच् aff.

ind.
Having reflected.
E.
वि before चित to think, ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being to be thought of or considered.
E.
वि before चिति to think, pass. v., शानच् aff.

mfn. (-न्वन्-न्वन्ती-न्वत्)
Thinking, considering.
E.
वि before चि to collect, aff. शतृ.

m. (-त्कः)
1 A hero.
2 Discrimination, judging.
E.
कन् added to the last.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Thinking, considering, deliberating.
E.
वि before चि to collect, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
1 Entered.
2 Occupied or inhabited by.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Unconscious, senseless, lifeless.
E.
वि priv. चेतना sense.

mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः)
1 Sad, perplexed, unhappy.
2 Ignorant, stupid.
E.
वि implying privation, चेतस् mind.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Investigated, ascertained, inquired into or looked after.
2 Inconsiderate, ill-judged.
n. (-तं)
1 Evil or malicious act.
2 Exertion, effort.
E.
वि before चेष्टित sought.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Thrown or slipped off.
2 Fallen or deviated from, neglecting, (as a duty.)
3 Sloughed.
E.
वि before च्युत fallen.

r. 6th cl. (विच्छायति)
To go or approach, (the form is irr.)
r. 10th cl. (विच्छयति)
1 To shine.
2 To speak.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 Cutting, cutting off, excision.
2 Dividing, fracture.
3 Separation or absence.
4 Loss, disappearance, destruction.
5 Cæsura, pause, in a verse.
6 The boundary or limits of a house, &c.
7 A property of the Nāyikā or mistress, carelessness or irregularity in dress and decoration through flurry and agitation.
7 Colouring the body with coloured unguents.
E.
वि before छिद to cut, aff. क्तिन्.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्नी-न्नं)
1 Cut, separated, severed.
2 Absent or separated from.
2 Divided, parted, portioned.
4 Shared, divided equally.
5 Crooked, curved.
6 Scattered, dispersed.
7 Hidden or cut off from view, intercepted.
E.
वि apart, छिद to cut, aff. क्त.

m. (-दः)
1 Separation, disjunction, removal.
2 Prohibition, prevention.
3 Dividing, cutting.
4 The division of a book, a section, a chapter.
5 Space, interval.
6 Dissension, difference.
E.
वि before छिद to cut, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
What separates, divides, cuts, &c.
m. (-कः)
A sector, a cutter.
E.
वि before छिद to cut, ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-नं)
Separating, severing, dividing.
E.
वि before छिद to cut, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Divisible, to be divided or separated.
E.
वि before छिद to cut, aff. अनीयर्.

m. (-ली)
The ocean.
E.
वीचि a wave, and माला a necklace, aff. इनि.
